title: **German chancellor acknowledges €100bn cost to Europe from Iran war**
text:
**German chancellor acknowledges €100bn cost to Europe from Iran war**"

"German Chancellor Friedrich Merz:"

"- Over the past eight months, Europe has borne an exorbitant cost of more than €100 billion."

"- This staggering figure stems entirely from the surge in energy prices caused by the continuation of the conflict."

"- European companies and consumers have paid this huge sum, as energy prices have risen sharply amid the crisis."

"- Europe therefore has a clear and immediate economic interest in bringing this conflict to an end as soon as possible."
